**Generated:** 2026-08-22T15:16:17.222Z · **Commit:** efeeca61 · **Nodes:** 160

Zero-runtime-dependency Node.js harness that coordinates Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Copilot, and Gemini-compatible agents through committed .agent state. Host rule or SessionStart hook -> shared BOARD/map/log context -> CLI and skill workflows -> verified task handoff. Project maps and skill evidence are Markdown/JSON files backed by Git; there is no database or application authentication layer.

**Stack:** JavaScript, Markdown, TOML, YAML, JSON

## Architecture

### Shared protocol and state

AGENTS.md and the committed .agent/ contract every host reads: board, thread, tasks, logs, map. The one canonical copy of each fact.


### Session runtime

lib/session.js, lib/work.js and lib/paths.js — per-session state under an owned root, session-scoped work evidence, and every bounded, symlink-refusing read of shared state.


### Hook enforcement

hooks/*.js. brief injects state at session start, work-track records what this session changed, clockout blocks the turn until its log exists, map-watch reports staleness. Generated registrations keep the plugin manifest and the settings installer in step.


### Install and ownership

lib/install.js with hooks/install.js and scripts/uninstall.js. One definition of what godkit created, so nothing it did not create is ever replaced or removed.


### CLI and map pipeline

bin/godkit.js over lib/scan.js, lib/batch.js, lib/graph.js, lib/freshness.js and lib/managed.js: scan, analyze, save, and honest staleness.


### Skills and evidence

skills/, agents/, commands/ and lib/evolve.js — the shipped procedures, plus project skills judged by owned snapshots and log-derived trust.


### Verification and release guards

tests/, scripts/sync-*.js, scripts/check-versions.js and the workflows. Generated files, agreeing manifests, a tag-only publish, and a packed-install smoke.
